notes: Site: Sitecore/.NET store (normann-copenhagen.com), English-first, direct HTTP fetch worked (homepage visited first for session cookies per prior access notes). Main nav has a top-level item 'News' (href /en/products/news) sitting as a peer to Furniture/Lighting/Accessories in the mega-menu - this is the site's own New Arrivals equivalent (the prior Home-Decor pass for this company independently flagged it as 'a New Arrivals marketing roll-up of items already counted in their home categories' and excluded it from category-decor scope, which is exactly expected overlap here). Opened /en/products/news/: it uses the site's standard category-tree PLP template - h1 'News', on-page copy 'Discover our latest news, designed with attention to craftsmanship...', a data-totalhits="37" counter on the .transientData div, and CustomSearch/GetResultsAjax pagination (same infrastructure verified exact on genuine category pages in the prior pass). Cross-checked qty by exhaustive pagination: page 0 = 33 unique product tiles, GetResultsAjax page=1 = 4 more (37 total), page=2 = 0 new - exact match against the declared data-totalhits=37. No genuine sub-structure under News (the left-menu shown on the page is the site's global category tree, not children of News itself) - single undifferentiated listing. Also checked: footer nav (no separate new-arrivals link), robots.txt (no Claude disallow), sitemap.xml (HTTP 500, unavailable), and site's own search for 'new arrivals', 'nyheder' (Danish), 'nyt'/'nyeste produkter' style terms and plain 'new in' - all English/Danish target-term searches returned 0 hits except literal 'new in' which matched 22 generic keyword hits (product names/descriptions containing the words 'new' or 'in'), not a dedicated PLP - excluded as search noise, not a genuine listing. Direct URL guesses /en/new-arrivals/, /en/new-in/ both resolve to the site's styled 404 page; /en/products/new-arrivals, /en/products/new both resolve to a bare homepage fallback. Conclusion: /en/products/news/ is the sole genuine New Arrivals PLP.
